profile_text.body:
Cisco is a publicly traded worldwide technology company (NASDAQ: CSCO, CIK 0000858877) that describes itself as a leader in AI infrastructure, secure networking, and software solutions. Its site positions the company across several domains, including AI-optimized networking, purpose-built programmable silicon for AI workloads, data center modernization, and embedded network security aimed at enterprises, hyperscalers, service providers, and campus environments. The company also promotes Cisco IQ, described as a unified AI-powered experience delivering real-time insights, troubleshooting, automation, and agent-driven guidance for support and professional services.

Cisco's tracked AI product is Cisco Webex AI, categorized under notes, knowledge, and meetings, and noted for meeting intelligence, real-time translation, noise removal, and enterprise security. More broadly, the company's site describes a push toward autonomous network operations, where policy-bound agents execute complex workflows at machine speed while human oversight governs intent, policy, and risk. The site also references the McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team as a customer relying on Cisco networking and security for AI workloads that process race data across 24 races worldwide.

No litigation or MCP server facts are held for Cisco at this time.
